Jordan / team — quick read & recommendation below. Short answers first: prioritize Grafana for log retention, negotiate pooled metrics with Datadog, and push for consolidated invoicing.

Notes:
- Cost: Grafana quote (logs+metrics retention) comes in ~40% cheaper for pure cold log storage vs Datadog list. Datadog's cross-account pool helps on metrics duplication but still higher overall. See attached cost sheet (rdw-cost-comparison-retention.xlsx).
- Risk: Grafana cold-tiering introduces a short SLA gap for ad-hoc analytics (expected query latency up to ~200ms for some large-range queries). SRE says that's acceptable for internal dashboards but not for customer-facing metrics.
- Negotiation levers:
  1) Commit to 12 months across both vendors in exchange for a cross-vendor discount — ask both to quote a bundled credit.
  2) Ask Datadog to cap ingest billing for 3 months during migration (ingest-neutral clause).
  3) Get Grafana to include the managed transfer (one-time) as credit against first invoice.
- Procurement: need vendor-standard W-9/SOWs and SOC2 attestation copies. Loop in SaaSProcure for PO issuance (they'll need invoice pdfs and vendor banking).

Suggested next steps (this week):
- Jordan: send consolidated commercial ask to both vendors (commitment + ask for bundled credit + migration credit) by 11/03 EOD.
- Markus: run an SLA/latency call with SRE this afternoon and confirm acceptable tail-latency thresholds.
- Hannah: confirm whether security is comfortable with cross-account pooling and what evidence they need (network runbook, IAM scoping).

Short reply is fine here if you agree. I can draft the plain-language negotiation bullet list to send.

Elena / Ravi — thanks for the quotes and quick turn. We're looking to finalize vendor commitments this week; below is a single set of negotiable items we want both teams to respond to by EOD 11/06. Our preference is a split architecture (Grafana for cold log storage, Datadog for high-cardinality metrics + alerts) but we are open to a bundled single-vendor proposal if the economics and SLAs align.

Consolidated ask:
- Term: 12-month committed term.
- Pricing: Provide best and final for the 12-month term; include any signup/early-signing credits.
- Bundled credit: If both vendors can coordinate a consolidated commercial (one invoicing owner or cross-credit), propose a combined credit schedule (target 15% total credit across vendors).
- Migration: Quote professional services for a managed transfer (Datadog -> Grafana cold), or a migration credit to offset runbook work. Include a firm SOW and estimated hours.
- Billing: Option A — single consolidated invoice handled by SaaSProcure (preferred). Option B — independent invoices but with a monthly reconciled credit. Please indicate which you support.
- SLA & latency: confirm worst-case query tail-latency on cold tiers and whether caching/KV approaches can be used to keep interactive dashboards under 200ms.
- Compliance: attach SOC2 report and confirm data residency for cold buckets.

Attachments: rdw-cost-comparison-retention.xlsx (summary of our expected usage), datadog-retention-quote-Nov2026.pdf, grafana-cloud-tiering-proposal-Nov2026.pdf

We'd like preliminary responses to each bullet by Friday EOD (11/06). Procurement (SaaSProcure) is CC'd to scope PO timing and required paperwork. If you want a quick 30-min alignment call tomorrow, suggest 11/04 10:00-10:30 PST.
